question: Do incident reports show the Matrice 30T behaving the way its manual describes after a lost link?

intake.reason: Assess whether incident reports show Matrice 30T behavior matching manual guidance on loss of control/link

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance states that when the connection cannot be reestablished, emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link should be started per AC 107-2A. It also directs trying to reestablish the control link and includes a preflight control link loss procedure. Manual evidence for the Matrice 30T is not found in this collection. Unverified incident reports state RTH at programmed altitude, including back-to-back hops, and a separate note that RTH initiated but did not respond when attempted. Gaps: no verified evidence that the Matrice 30T behavior matches the manual after loss of link, and claims of interference near the antenna lack official guidance in this collection.

claims.text: When the connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link, per AC 107-2A guidance.
claims.quote: If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.

claims.text: If the hazard occurs, attempt to reestablish the link by directing: "Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft."
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.

claims.text: AC 107-2A requires that the preflight briefing include control link loss procedures.
claims.quote: The preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures.

sections.label: DJI Matrice 30T manual
sections.abstain_reason: The supplied passages contain only the DJI Matrice 30T manual and do not include any incident reports or records describing lost-link behavior.

claims.text: When a lost link occurs, the UAS performs RTH at programmed altitude, with reports stating 'Lost link and RTH occurred twice on back-to-back hops' and 'UAS RTH at programmed altitude without issue'.
claims.quote: Lost link and RTH occurred twice on back-to-back hops

claims.text: The reporter states "I attempted to place the drone into RTH without success; the RTH initiated but did not respond" (loss of control; RTH command failed)
claims.quote: I attempted to place the drone into RTH without success; the RTH initiated but did not respond

claims.text: The same report notes the camera feed was not lost during the incident, with 'Camera feed was never lost during the incident'.
claims.quote: Camera feed was never lost during the incident

claims.text: The reporter states "repeated testing shows interference with the flight controller within 5 feet of the antenna" (interference near antenna)
claims.quote: repeated testing shows interference with the flight controller within 5 feet of the antenna

gaps.text: FAA guidance requires emergency procedures after loss of link; incident reports claim RTH occurs at programmed altitude, sometimes back-to-back.
FAA guidance instructs attempting to reestablish the control link; incident reports describe RTH command failures when reestablish attempts fail.
No usable evidence found in the approved collection for DJI Matrice 30T manual.
No verified evidence in the approved collection that the Matrice 30T behavior matches the manual's post-loss-link description.
Interference near the antenna is claimed; official guidance on its impact is not provided in this collection.
